subject: Next steps: prompt batch & redaction guidance for Equinox Health trial
messages:
From: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
To: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@equinoxhealth.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 15:12:00 -0400
Subject: Next steps: prompt batch & redaction guidance for Equinox Health trial

Hi Sara —

Thanks again for the time earlier. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we keep momentum on the pilot: 

1) What we heard from the call
- Primary use case: clinician-assistant for summarizing triage notes and surfacing prior procedures.
- Volume: ~200–400 prompt interactions/day in early pilot; latency target <150ms p95 for common queries.
- Sensitive data concern: PHI (patient names, MRNs) and free-text notes with provider identifiers.

2) Redwood recommendations for model/eval phase
- Suggested starter models: open-weight Llama-2-70B-q4f/Redwood-optimized and a distilled 13B quantized variant for cost/latency comparisons.
- Benchmarks: we will run the triage-summary suite (link below) and return token-level latency/cost and rouge/qa pass rates.

3) Action items (owner and timeline)
- Equinox: provide a 100–200 prompt sample set with edge cases and redaction notes by May 10 (Sara + Mike).
- Redwood: share a redaction checklist and prompt-schema template by EOD May 4 (Ben).
- Redwood: run a quickbench with both model variants and deliver results within 5 business days of sample receipt.

Attached is a short example schema we use (columns: prompt_id, text, expected_behavior, sensitivity_flags) — feel free to drop samples into the Drive folder we created (linked below).

On privacy: we can accept de-identified samples for the initial run. If you prefer, Redact PHI per the checklist and we will show a sample redaction pipeline before ingest.

Would you like us to schedule a 30-min intake session with your clinical SME to walk through edge cases? I can propose times for Wed/Thu next week.

Thanks,
Grace

--
Grace O'Connor
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com | +1 415-555-0123
Redwood Inference

From: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@equinoxhealth.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@equinoxhealth.com>
Date: Mon, 4 May 2026 17:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: prompt batch & redaction guidance for Equinox Health trial

Hi Grace —

Thanks for the clear recap. This aligns with our expectations. Quick clarifications:

- We'll target 150 sample prompts (mix of triage notes and clinician follow-ups) and include ~20 edge cases (abbreviations, shorthand, duplicated patient references).
- For PHI: we'd prefer to send de-identified text initially, but we want to confirm Redwood's recommended redaction heuristics so our engineering team can run a local scrub before upload.

Yes to the intake session — Wed May 12th at 11:00 AM ET would work for our clinical lead (Dr. Patel). Can you send a calendar invite?

Appreciate the quick turnaround on benchmarking. We'll aim to have samples in the Drive by May 10.

Best,
Sara

--
Sara Thomas
Director of Clinical AI, Equinox Health
sara.thomas@equinoxhealth.com | (617) 555-3344

From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>, Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@equinoxhealth.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 5 May 2026 09:18:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: prompt batch & redaction guidance for Equinox Health trial

Sara / Grace —

Attaching the redaction checklist and an example prompt schema (CSV) we use for pilot ingestion. Quick notes inside the checklist: 
- Preferred approach: pseudonymize names and replace MRNs with token markers (e.g., [MRN]).
- Remove or hash patient contact info and free-text notes that contain social identifiers.
- For edge cases (shared references across prompts), mark sensitivity_flags = "cross_ref" in the schema so we can handle context linking offline.

Drive link to the sample folder: https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1a2b3cPromptSamples
HubSpot trial record: https://hubspot.example.com/deal/EQX-2026-TRIAL-47

I'll also attach a tiny prompt sample CSV with three exemplars to show formatting. If you want, Monica can run a one-off local redaction demo with your samples when you upload them.

On the model side — we'll estimate token cost for both variants and include a brief note about expected latency ranges given your volume profile.

Thanks,
Ben

Attachments: redaction-checklist-v1.pdf, prompt-schema-example.csv

--
Ben Carter
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
ben_carter@redwoodinference.com | +1 650-555-0199

From: Mike Alvarez <mike.alvarez@equinoxhealth.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwoodinference.com>, Grace O'Connor <grace.oconnor@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Sara Thomas <sara.thomas@equinoxhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 6 May 2026 11:03:00 -0400
Subject: Re: Next steps: prompt batch & redaction guidance for Equinox Health trial

Ben — appreciate the artifacts. Quick confirmation from our side:

- We uploaded the 150-sample CSV to the Drive folder you created (file: EQX_prompt_batch_20260505.csv). It includes the 20 edge cases flagged with sensitivity_flags = cross_ref or phi.
- We'll leave Dr. Patel's intake meeting on Wed May 12; Sara will send a calendar invite to the Redwood attendees.
- One ask: can Redwood include in the bench report a short section describing false-positive/false-negative redaction examples you observed during your run so we can iterate on scrub heuristics?

If you can confirm that and the expected delivery date for the quickbench, we'll proceed.

Thanks,
Mike
